checks.description: The explicit findings — at least one; validation is never silent.

checkId.description: Stable check identifier (e.g. geometry.dimensions-positive, units.quantity-units-typed, operation.ordering-dependencies).

detail.description: Deterministic finding detail — what passed, failed, is unknown or needs review. Never silent, never fabricated.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

engine.description: The deterministic validation engine that produced the snapshot.

kind.description: The deterministic validation engine kind (e.g. aise-solution-engine) — provider identity belongs in provenance.

inputDigest.description: sha-256 digest of the validated solution-version content — the snapshot certifies EXACTLY these bytes.

outcome.description: Worst-of the checks: fail > review-needed > unknown > pass (invariant validation_outcome_not_worst_of_checks).

validatedAt.description: Validation instant; EXCLUDED from the snapshot identity derivation.

versionNumber.description: The validated solution version (the snapshot is version-pinned).
